what: Step 4 entry compatibility FINALIZE lacks the explicit set +e / capture / warn / exit pattern spelled out for the Step 3b completion fence
scenario_or_breakage: Under set -e the driver can exit before the repair warning is printed; FM6 and the new exit pins treat warning-only as a failure
suggested_fix: Mirror item 3 in item 4: wrap compatibility FINALIZE in set +e, capture _finalize_rc, print the repair warning on non-zero, then exit "$_finalize_rc"
